say:0:1223201001:0.text: Chippy wonders how the Water Wights are faring with their job hunt in Rustport.
say:0:1223201001:0.source_cn: 不知道水鬼帮在锈锚港找工作找的怎么样了？

say:3:1223202002:1.text: Have you guys found a job?

say:8:1223202005:1.text: Thoreau's in trouble in the upper district. Could you go take a look?
say:8:1223202005:1.source_cn: 梭罗在上城区遇到点麻烦，你能去看下吗？

say:9:1223202006:1.text: See? I knew trouble would find us. Care to join me?
say:9:1223202006:1.source_cn: 你瞧，又来了。要跟我一起去看看吗？

say:12:1223202007:1.text: Sure, but just to be clear, we aren't here to help. We just want to keep an eye on you!
say:12:1223202007:1.source_cn: 看热闹可以，但先说好，我们不是来帮忙的，我们是来监督你们的！

say:13:1223202008:1.text: Naturally. In fact, just having you around can help me solve a lot of problems!
say:13:1223202008:1.source_cn: 当然，当然。其实只要你们站在我们身边，就能解决很多问题了！

say:14:1223202009:1.text: Let's head out first. We don't know what might happen if we're late.
say:14:1223202009:1.source_cn: 不说了，快点走出发吧，去晚了还不知道会发生什么。

say:0:1223203001:0.text: I'll show you the way to the upper district.

say:2:1223204001:1.text: Hey, we agreed on the rate! Are you trying to weasel out of paying?!
say:2:1223204001:1.source_cn: 混蛋啊！我们谈好的价格，你想赖账吗？！

say:3:1223204002:1.text: It's funny to hear that accusation coming from a Water Wight.
say:3:1223204002:1.source_cn: 赖账？这句话从你们水鬼帮嘴里说出来真是好笑。

say:4:1223204003:1.text: Isn't this what you and your fellow thugs specialize in? Did you ever pay for the things you took from us?
say:4:1223204003:1.source_cn: 这不是你们最擅长的吗，抢我们东西的时候，你们付过钱了吗？

say:5:1223204004:1.text: Just cut the crap and pay for my hours!
say:5:1223204004:1.source_cn: 别耍嘴皮子，帮你做了事，你就得付钱！

say:6:1223204005:1.text: I will after you pay for what you stole before.
say:6:1223204005:1.source_cn: 行啊，你先付抢的东西的钱。

say:7:1223204006:1.text: Don't play games with me or you'll regret it!
say:7:1223204006:1.source_cn: 别耍心眼，想吃点苦头是吧？

say:8:1223204007:1.text: Just try laying a finger on me! Everyone's watching!
say:8:1223204007:1.source_cn: 你们敢动手吗？这段时间，大家都提着一口气盯着你们呢。

say:9:1223204008:1.text: If you touch me, you'll ruin your hard-earned...
say:9:1223204008:1.source_cn: 你们要是动手，好不容易建立起来的……

say:15:1223204010:1.text: Sir Chippy is here! No bullying is allowed under my watch, even if the victim's a Water Wight!
say:15:1223204010:1.source_cn: 仓鼠骑士满满，不允许坏蛋在这里欺负人，即使欺负的是水鬼...

say:16:1223204011:1.text: I see you've got some help. Do you think I'm scared?
say:16:1223204011:1.source_cn: 好啊！你还叫了人是吧？我怕你们？

say:3:1223205001:1.text: Argh! Can't believe you're siding with the Water Wights to hurt honest folks like myself! I'm going to tell everyone about this!
say:3:1223205001:1.source_cn: 可恶，你们居然帮水鬼欺负我，我要告诉所有人！

say:4:1223205002:1.text: Don't try and spin this like we're the bad guys. Thoreau did work for you. You have to pay him—plain and simple.
say:4:1223205002:1.source_cn: 别颠倒是非，既然他给你干了活，不管怎样，你要付干活的钱。

say:5:1223205003:1.text: As for your past grievances, that's a different matter.
say:5:1223205003:1.source_cn: 至于之前的恩怨，那是另一回事。

say:6:1223205004:1.text: Precisely. Chippy hates it when people abuse their power to settle personal scores! Keeping things separate is the mark of a true knight!
say:6:1223205004:1.source_cn: 没错，满满最讨厌公报私仇。一码归一码，才是骑士的美德！

say:7:1223205005:1.text: If you keep bullying Thoreau, we'll send you to the Carmine Whispers. They'll give you a fair trial!
say:7:1223205005:1.source_cn: 你要是栽赃陷害，我们就把你送去血薇帮，他们会给恶人公平...

say:8:1223205006:1.text: Wait! I was just messing with you just now! Here's what I agreed to pay... Or you can have all of it!
say:8:1223205006:1.source_cn: 别！我刚才跟你们开玩笑呢，这是答应给水鬼的钱，啊不，全...

say:14:1223205008:1.text: Thoreau, only take what's rightfully yours.
say:14:1223205008:1.source_cn: 梭罗，只拿该拿的那一份。

say:15:1223205009:0.text: B—But... it's free money. Didn't you teach us to seize everything we can before?
say:15:1223205009:0.source_cn: 可、可是……不拿白不拿，水鬼就该连拿带兜，这不是你教我...

say:16:1223205010:1.text: That's when we were robbers. Things are different now.
say:16:1223205010:1.source_cn: 那是做劫匪的时候，和现在能一样吗？

say:17:1223205011:1.text: Alright, I hear ya... This is all for our new life.
say:17:1223205011:1.source_cn: 行吧，听你的，为了……新生活！

say:18:1223205012:1.text: Keep your filthy money! We aren't thugs anymore! We only take what's ours!
say:18:1223205012:1.source_cn: 喂！拿走你的臭钱！我们现在不是劫匪了！只拿该拿的！

say:19:1223205013:1.text: You actually have principles now. It's my fault for underestimating you.
say:19:1223205013:1.source_cn: 没想到你们还挺有原则，小看你们了。

say:20:1223205014:1.text: What are you looking at? Go away!

say:21:1223205015:1.text: Hmph, once a Water Wight, always a Water Wight! You'll never change!
say:21:1223205015:1.source_cn: 哼，再怎么变，一天是水鬼，一辈子都是水鬼，认命吧！

say:25:1223205016:1.text: These people are getting under my skin! When will they stop disrespecting me?
say:25:1223205016:1.source_cn: 真烦！一个两个的，都朝老子吐口水，什么时候是个头？

say:26:1223205017:1.text: Be patient. The sun always rise above the sea, and we're experts at waiting on the water, remember?
say:26:1223205017:1.source_cn: 耐心一点，海上的太阳总会升起。咱们最擅长的，不就是等太...

say:27:1223205018:1.text: By the way, where's Cecil? Isn't he with you?
say:27:1223205018:1.source_cn: 对了，西索呢，不是和你在一起吗？

say:28:1223205019:1.text: He went to another street to look for work, and he's been away for quite some time. He could've run into some trouble as well.
say:28:1223205019:1.source_cn: 他去另外一条街找活了，这么久不回来，八成也碰到挑事情的了。

say:29:1223205020:1.text: Let's check on him. Bring me there.

say:1:1223205102:0.text: I've done all this work for nothing. Do you think I have money to spare?!
say:1:1223205102:0.source_cn: 我都白干了，你觉得我有钱赔吗？！

say:2:1223207001:0.text: Hey! I know some of your stuff went missing, but there's no need to make such a big deal out of it!
say:2:1223207001:0.source_cn: 喂！不就是弄丢了你的东西吗？叫嚷什么！

say:3:1223207002:0.text: Everyone! I have with me a sneaky theiving Water Wight here!
say:3:1223207002:0.source_cn: 大家快来看啊，水鬼耍赖了！

say:4:1223207003:1.text: Not only did he refuse to compensate me for losing my stuff, but he also threatened me with violence!
say:4:1223207003:1.source_cn: 不仅弄丢了我的东西不赔钱，还威胁要打我！

say:5:1223207004:1.text: I had to carry so many things back and forth! How can you blame me for losing a box or two?
say:5:1223207004:1.source_cn: 谁让你的东西那么多，来回搬来搬去，丢了能怪我吗？

say:6:1223207005:1.text: Enough with the excuses and pay up! Or I'll get the Carmine Whispers here!
say:6:1223207005:1.source_cn: 你……你！少废话，赔钱！不然我就找血薇帮来了！

say:8:1223207006:1.text: Relax, Sir. Just let us know the how much you want, and we'll cover it.
say:8:1223207006:1.source_cn: 老板别担心，你给个数，我们赔！

say:10:1223207008:1.text: That's daylight robbery! How can two crates of fruit be worth that much?!
say:10:1223207008:1.source_cn: 你打劫呢？！两箱水果值这么多钱？！

say:11:1223207009:1.text: That amount includes the cost of the damaged goods, the delay, and the emotional damage you've caused me. I could ask for more if you want.
say:11:1223207009:1.source_cn: 货品损失费，误工费，以及我的心情损失费，一万金币，我还...

say:12:1223207010:1.text: Damn it! There's no way I'm forking over this money!
say:12:1223207010:1.source_cn: 妈的！老子今天要是给了这个钱，以后在兄弟们面前头都抬不起！

say:13:1223207011:1.text: How about I replace one of your teeth with a golden one? That'll fetch a pretty penny...
say:13:1223207011:1.source_cn: 要钱是吧？我给你换颗金牙吧？金牙多值钱——

say:14:1223207012:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! This Water Wight's going pry out one of my teeth!
say:14:1223207012:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! This Water Wight's going pry out one of my teeth!
say:14:1223207012:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! This Water Wight's going pry out one of my teeth!

say:18:1223207013:1.text: Cecil, I understand you're angry, so I won't stop you from whatever you want to do.
say:18:1223207013:1.source_cn: 西索，你心里有火，我不拦你。

say:19:1223207014:1.text: But I want you to think twice—do you want to end up in jail along with Ralph?
say:19:1223207014:1.source_cn: 你想清楚，这一拳下去，你就能去和关在审判庭的劳夫做邻居了。

say:20:1223207015:1.text: Kraken's spit! Who has ten thousand gold just lying around?!
say:20:1223207015:1.source_cn: 妈的！难道你有一万金币？！

say:25:1223207017:0.text: Don't look at us! Even if we had that kind of money, we aren't paying for you!
say:25:1223207017:0.source_cn: 别看我们，我们就算有，这个钱也该你们自己赔！

say:27:1223207018:0.text: Exactly. After all, you're the one responsible for the missing items!
say:27:1223207018:0.source_cn: 没错，毕竟你弄丢了别人的东西！

say:29:1223207019:1.text: Why don't you try negotiating for a lower amount?
say:29:1223207019:1.source_cn: 如果钱不够，试着向对方砍价呢？

say:30:1223207020:1.text: Negotiate? I only know how to cut throats, not handle figures.

say:35:1223207023:0.text: Let's give it a try then.
say:35:1223207023:0.male: Let's give it a try then.
say:35:1223207023:0.female: Let's give it a try then.

choice:32:1:2.text: Negotiation is what I do best.
choice:32:1:2.male: Negotiation is what I do best.
choice:32:1:2.female: Negotiation is what I do best.

say:37:1223207022:0.text: That's right! The Magister's good at negotiating for discounts and many other stuff!
say:37:1223207022:0.source_cn: 没错，主人不仅擅长砍价，也擅长砍……呃，总感觉这样说怪怪的！
say:37:1223207022:0.male: That's right! The Magister's good at negotiating for discounts and many other stuff!
say:37:1223207022:0.female: That's right! The Magister's good at negotiating for discounts and many other stuff!

say:2:1223208001:1.text: I said ten thousand gold, and I mean it!
say:2:1223208001:1.source_cn: 一万金币，一个子都不能少！
say:2:1223208001:1.male: I said ten thousand gold, and I mean it!
say:2:1223208001:1.female: I said ten thousand gold, and I mean it!

say:3:1223208002:1.text: Sir, we're willing to pay, but you should keep your demand reasonable.
say:3:1223208002:1.source_cn: 老板，我们愿意赔偿，但是您也不能狮子大开口，漫天要价呀。

say:4:1223208003:1.text: The two boxes of fruit are imported from overseas, so they are pricier!
say:4:1223208003:1.source_cn: 我那两箱不是本地水果，是外地商船运回来的，进货价就要贵一点！
say:4:1223208003:1.male: The two boxes of fruit are imported from overseas, so they are pricier!
say:4:1223208003:1.female: The two boxes of fruit are imported from overseas, so they are pricier!

say:5:1223208004:1.text: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
say:5:1223208004:1.source_cn: 而且我这批水果断货了，竞争对手就会把他的货临时涨价，我...
say:5:1223208004:1.male: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
say:5:1223208004:1.female: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.

choice_prompt:6:1223208004.text: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
choice_prompt:6:1223208004.source_cn: 而且我这批水果断货了，竞争对手就会把他的货临时涨价，我这损失可就大咯。
choice_prompt:6:1223208004.male: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.
choice_prompt:6:1223208004.female: Now that I have no more stock of the fruit, my competitors will jack up their prices. I'm going to take a big hit.

say:7:1223208005:0.text: Is this how you usually deal with merchants? Well... I don't accept your offer.
say:7:1223208005:0.source_cn: 你平时是这样跟商人打交道的吗？呵、呵……那我只能说，我...
say:7:1223208005:0.male: Is this how you usually deal with merchants? Well... I don't accept your offer.
say:7:1223208005:0.female: Is this how you usually deal with merchants? Well... I don't accept your offer.

say:8:1223208021:0.text: Just settle the payment now, alright? I've already compromised a lot.
say:8:1223208021:0.source_cn: 行了，交钱吧，我已经让的够多了。

say:11:1223208022:1.text: Here's the money, buddy. I apologize on Cecil's behalf for losing your goods.
say:11:1223208022:1.source_cn: 哥们，这是赔偿金，实在对不住哈，这小子粗心大意弄丢了您的货。

say:12:1223208023:1.text: Don't "buddy" me. Save your pleasantries for others.
say:12:1223208023:1.source_cn: 谁是你哥们？客套话就免了。

say:13:1223208024:1.text: Well, we're practically friends now. Next time you need our services, we'll give you a discount.
say:13:1223208024:1.source_cn: 不打不相识，下次您找我们干活，给您友情价。

say:14:1223208025:1.text: Hmph... I guess you're the smart one of the group. We'll see.

say:19:1223208026:0.text: I'm surprised. You're pretty business savvy. You even promoted your business at the end.
say:19:1223208026:0.source_cn: 看不出来嘛，你还算细心，懂得为自己招揽生意。

say:20:1223208027:1.text: I've picked up a few skills lately. Anyway, we owe you a big one this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! If it weren't for you, that landlubber would've cheated us blind.
say:20:1223208027:1.source_cn: 都是这段时间学会的，太感谢<style=stress>...
say:20:1223208027:1.male: I've picked up a few skills lately. Anyway, we owe you a big one this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! If it weren't for you, that landlubber would've cheated us blind.
say:20:1223208027:1.female: I've picked up a few skills lately. Anyway, we owe you a big one this time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! If it weren't for you, that landlubber would've cheated us blind.

say:23:1223208028:0.text: Cecil, go and get Paz. It's time to head back to the camp.
say:23:1223208028:0.source_cn: 西索，去叫上帕斯，该回营地了。

say:24:1223208029:0.text: Paz isn't feeling well, and he's already gone back to the camp.
say:24:1223208029:0.source_cn: 帕斯他情况不太好，已经先回营地了。

say:26:1223208031:1.text: You'll find out when you see him.

say:28:1223208006:1.text: That's right. Every official merchant ship keeps proof of delivery, and we can use it to identify the missing fruit before compensating according to the market price.
say:28:1223208006:1.source_cn: 没错，每艘官方认可的商船都会有出货记录，我们要确定那是...

say:29:1223208007:1.text: If you can't provide evidence, it means your goods are smuggled... The Carmine Whispers won't go easy on you if they find out!
say:29:1223208007:1.source_cn: 如果你不能提供证据，就说明你这几箱水果是偷渡的……如果...

say:31:1223208009:1.text: We won't report you, but you have to accept our offer.
say:31:1223208009:1.source_cn: 如果没有进出货证明的话，我们可以不举报给血薇帮，但只能...

say:32:1223208010:1.text: Quite a bargain for you, huh?

say:33:1223208011:1.text: Hmph, since you mentioned the Carmine Whispers, I'll be the bigger man here and accept your offer.
say:33:1223208011:1.source_cn: 哼，都搬出血薇帮了，那就不和你们计较那么多了。

choice:6:1:2.text: Prove the price of the fruit.
choice:6:1:2.male: Prove the price of the fruit.
choice:6:1:2.female: Prove the price of the fruit.

say:34:1223208012:1.text: If you want to factor in your additional losses, we'll also need to account for our manpower costs to keep things fair.
say:34:1223208012:1.source_cn: 如果你要计较额外的损失，公平起见，我们这边也要计算损失...

say:37:1223208013:1.text: Right! You haven't paid me for my work yet!

say:38:1223208014:1.text: This makes no sense. Hmph... Are you suggesting that I have to compensate you instead?
say:38:1223208014:1.source_cn: 这叫什么道理？呵……难道我还要赔偿你们吗？

say:41:1223208015:1.text: Of course not. It's only fair for Cecil to compensate for the goods he lost.
say:41:1223208015:1.source_cn: 当然没有这意思，他弄丢了货物，赔偿是应该的。

say:42:1223208016:1.text: But he hasn't even been paid for his work. How is he supposed to come up with the money for you?
say:42:1223208016:1.source_cn: 但他连工钱都没拿到，怎么有钱赔你呢？

say:43:1223208017:1.text: You need to settle his wages first before he can pay.
say:43:1223208017:1.source_cn: 为了让他有钱赔你，你要先结清工钱。

say:45:1223208019:1.text: Wait, no! I'd end up getting paid less if that's the case! I nearly fell for your trick!
say:45:1223208019:1.source_cn: 不，不！这样我得到的赔偿就少了，好险，差点就被你们糊弄了。

say:46:1223208020:1.text: Fine, I'll give you all a discount. Today just isn't my day.
say:46:1223208020:1.source_cn: 这样吧，给你们少一点，算我倒霉。

say:3:1223209002:0.text: What's going on, Paz? How come you look so sick?
say:3:1223209002:0.source_cn: 怎么回事，帕斯，怎么跟个痨病鬼似的。

say:5:1223209004:0.text: Get hold of yourself! Your knees are buckling!
say:5:1223209004:0.source_cn: 喂！站稳了！怎么还摔倒了！

say:7:1223209006:0.text: Let me see... You're burning up! You have a fever, idiot!
say:7:1223209006:0.source_cn: 让我看看，温度这么高？！帕斯发烧了，该死！

say:8:1223209007:0.text: This is not something you can just tough it out! Hey, you alright?! Talk to me, Paz!
say:8:1223209007:0.source_cn: 能挺过去吗？帕斯，回答我！

say:12:1223209009:0.text: He's in bad shape; he needs medication immediately.
say:12:1223209009:0.source_cn: 他的情况看起来很糟糕，得赶紧用药。

say:13:1223209010:0.text: Barnacles! We got no medicine right now!

choice_prompt:14:1223209010.text: Barnacles! We got no medicine right now!

say:15:1223209011:1.text: I mean everybody gets sick one time or another. We usually just tough it out.
say:15:1223209011:1.source_cn: 生病很常见，一般都能硬挨过去。
say:15:1223209011:1.male: I mean everybody gets sick one time or another. We usually just tough it out.
say:15:1223209011:1.female: I mean everybody gets sick one time or another. We usually just tough it out.

say:16:1223209012:1.text: If things get real bad, we'll make fish soup or use some herbs.
say:16:1223209012:1.source_cn: 实在情况糟糕，就熬一大碗鱼汤或者搞点药草。
say:16:1223209012:1.male: If things get real bad, we'll make fish soup or use some herbs.
say:16:1223209012:1.female: If things get real bad, we'll make fish soup or use some herbs.

say:17:1223209013:1.text: But we don't have time to prepare any of those now!
say:17:1223209013:1.source_cn: 可恶，现在去弄鱼汤和药草也来不及了！
say:17:1223209013:1.male: But we don't have time to prepare any of those now!
say:17:1223209013:1.female: But we don't have time to prepare any of those now!

say:22:1223209017:0.text: You guys are lucky. Your friend would be in danger if weren't for the Magister.
say:22:1223209017:0.source_cn: 你们运气好，要不是主人会炼药，他就危险了。
say:22:1223209017:0.male: You guys are lucky. Your friend would be in danger if weren't for the Magister.
say:22:1223209017:0.female: You guys are lucky. Your friend would be in danger if weren't for the Magister.

say:23:1223209018:0.text: If you manage to save Paz, we Water Wights will forever be in your debt!
say:23:1223209018:0.source_cn: 如果你能救我兄弟，以后水鬼让你随便差遣！
say:23:1223209018:0.male: If you manage to save Paz, we Water Wights will forever be in your debt!
say:23:1223209018:0.female: If you manage to save Paz, we Water Wights will forever be in your debt!

say:26:1223209019:1.text: You don't need to make that promise. There's nothing we need from you anyway.
say:26:1223209019:1.source_cn: 咳咳，倒也不用发这样的誓言，我们也没什么需要差遣你们的。

say:27:1223209020:0.text: Just know that the magister's <style="highlight">anti-fever elixir</style> is going to cure Paz.
say:27:1223209020:0.male: Just know that the magister's <style="highlight">anti-fever elixir</style> is going to cure Paz.
say:27:1223209020:0.female: Just know that the magister's <style="highlight">anti-fever elixir</style> is going to cure Paz.

say:30:1223209014:1.text: We can't afford a doctor, and those doctors look down on us.
say:30:1223209014:1.source_cn: ……我们从来没钱去看医生，那些医生也不待见我们。
say:30:1223209014:1.male: We can't afford a doctor, and those doctors look down on us.
say:30:1223209014:1.female: We can't afford a doctor, and those doctors look down on us.

say:31:1223209015:1.text: His teeth are chattering. If we don't act soon, it'll be hard to feed him the medicine later.
say:31:1223209015:1.source_cn: 他牙齿都在打颤了，再过一会怕是药都灌不进去。
say:31:1223209015:1.male: His teeth are chattering. If we don't act soon, it'll be hard to feed him the medicine later.
say:31:1223209015:1.female: His teeth are chattering. If we don't act soon, it'll be hard to feed him the medicine later.

say:0:1223210001:0.source_cn: 小水村西北方向的山坡，有<style=highligh...
say:0:1223210001:0.male: The herbs needed to make the <style="highlight">anti-fever elixir</style> can be found on the hills to the northwest of Brineville.
say:0:1223210001:0.female: The herbs needed to make the <style="highlight">anti-fever elixir</style> can be found on the hills to the northwest of Brineville.

say:0:1223211001:0.text: The ingredients for the anti-fever elixir are here.
say:0:1223211001:0.source_cn: 炼制驱热药剂的材料就在这里。
say:0:1223211001:0.male: The ingredients for the anti-fever elixir are here.
say:0:1223211001:0.female: The ingredients for the anti-fever elixir are here.

say:0:1223212001:0.text: We've got all the ingredients. Let's prepare the potion.
say:0:1223212001:0.source_cn: 材料收集齐了，去炼药吧。
say:0:1223212001:0.male: We've got all the ingredients. Let's prepare the potion.
say:0:1223212001:0.female: We've got all the ingredients. Let's prepare the potion.

document:0:78:0.text:
Crafted from natural herbs, this elixir has a refreshing scent that soothes the mind. Those with high fever recover instantly after consumption.
Typically brewed from the <style="highlight">iris roots, verdunt leaves, and wildgreen tree bark</style>.
document:0:78:0.source_cn:
汇集了自然药材的清凉熬制成的药剂，仿佛能嗅到一丝凉意沁人心脾。高热患者服下可立刻痊愈。
一般由<style="highlight">菘花根，爵蓝小青叶，野青树皮</style>熬制而成。

say:2:1223214001:1.text: It's all thanks to the Magister's potion that you woke up so quickly!
say:2:1223214001:1.source_cn: 没错，多亏主人亲自为你调制药剂，你才能这么快醒来！
say:2:1223214001:1.male: It's all thanks to the Magister's potion that you woke up so quickly!
say:2:1223214001:1.female: It's all thanks to the Magister's potion that you woke up so quickly!

say:6:1223214003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved your life, so he's one of us now. Go ahead and finish drinking that potion.
say:6:1223214003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved your life, so he's one of us now. Go ahead and finish drinking that potion.
say:6:1223214003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved your life, so she's one of us now. Go ahead and finish drinking that potion.

say:8:1223214005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I talk to you for a second?
say:8:1223214005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I talk to you for a second?
say:8:1223214005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I talk to you for a second?

say:2:1223215001:0.text: We can't keep going like this...
say:2:1223215001:0.male: We can't keep going like this...
say:2:1223215001:0.female: We can't keep going like this...

say:3:1223215002:0.text: Cecil, you all go and rest. I'm having a chat with <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:3:1223215002:0.source_cn: 西索，你们也去休息吧。我和<style=stress>...
say:3:1223215002:0.male: Cecil, you all go and rest. I'm having a chat with <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:3:1223215002:0.female: Cecil, you all go and rest. I'm having a chat with <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:4:1223215003:0.text: Rest? How can we rest when our roof's been leaking for months? When will we have the money to fix it?
say:4:1223215003:0.source_cn: 休息？哪还顾得上休息，屋顶都漏水好几个月了，什么时候有...

say:5:1223215004:0.text: It's definitely on our to-do list, but we're in the red again today.
say:5:1223215004:0.source_cn: 不是不修，只是今天的进账，又是负的。

say:6:1223215005:0.text: If we're going to lose money every day, we might as well just give up now and find a hole to die in.
say:6:1223215005:0.source_cn: 啊？要我说，照这样天天负进账，不如直接一步到位，大家啥...

say:7:1223215006:0.text: I heard a typhoon is coming soon. Let's just let it bring us to the great beyond.
say:7:1223215006:0.source_cn: 正好，马上台风要来了，等台风一来，大家一起上天！

say:10:1223215007:1.text: Don't lose heart just yet. We need to believe in Al. He's been trying his best...
say:10:1223215007:1.source_cn: 别这样说，我们要相信阿尔，他是个有本事的……

say:11:1223215008:1.text: How long have things been like this? Not only have we not made a single dime, but we're losing money every day. If <style="stress"><player_name></style> wasn't here today, Paz would've died on the street like a sea slug!
say:11:1223215008:1.source_cn: 这都多久了？我们不仅没挣钱还天天赔钱，今天要不是有<s...
say:11:1223215008:1.male: How long have things been like this? Not only have we not made a single dime, but we're losing money every day. If <style="stress"><player_name></style> wasn't here today, Paz would've died on the street like a sea slug!
say:11:1223215008:1.female: How long have things been like this? Not only have we not made a single dime, but we're losing money every day. If <style="stress"><player_name></style> wasn't here today, Paz would've died on the street like a sea slug!

say:12:1223215009:1.text: I say we shouldn't have hoped for a fresh start in Rustport. Al's idea is a total flop!
say:12:1223215009:1.source_cn: 要我说，就不该幻想在锈锚港重新开始，都怪阿尔出的馊主意！

say:13:1223215010:1.text: See how exhausted everyone is. We work from dawn till dusk, only to get yelled and have our money taken away!
say:13:1223215010:1.source_cn: 你看看大家都被累成啥样了，每天早出晚归，出力被骂还赔钱！

say:16:1223215011:1.text: Alright, I know you're all upset. Why not just vent it all out now?
say:16:1223215011:1.source_cn: 行吧，知道你们不痛快，要不现在骂个爽？

say:17:1223215012:1.text: *Sigh* Life was so great back in the old days...
say:17:1223215012:1.source_cn: 唉，想想以前，咱们多痛快……

say:20:1223215013:1.text: Don't bring up the past if you want to stay alive.
say:20:1223215013:1.source_cn: 哥们，如果不想死，就别提以前了。

choice_prompt:21:1223215013.text: Don't bring up the past if you want to stay alive.
choice_prompt:21:1223215013.source_cn: 哥们，如果不想死，就别提以前了。

say:22:1223215014:1.text: We wouldn't dare. With you on the Carmine Whispers' side, we're no match for them.
say:22:1223215014:1.source_cn: 我们哪敢啊，血薇帮有了你这个帮手，我们只有被按在地上打的份。
say:22:1223215014:1.male: We wouldn't dare. With you on the Carmine Whispers' side, we're no match for them.
say:22:1223215014:1.female: We wouldn't dare. With you on the Carmine Whispers' side, we're no match for them.

say:26:1223215017:0.text: Actually, I've been wondering—since things are so tough in Rustport, why don't you just leave? You have boats, after all.
say:26:1223215017:0.source_cn: 其实我心里有个疑问，你们都有船，在锈锚港呆不下去的话，...

say:27:1223215018:1.text: Hammie's got a point. Since the port has reopened, you're free to leave whenever you want!
say:27:1223215018:1.source_cn: 对呀，港口也解锁了，你们想走随时都能走啊！

say:32:1223215020:1.text: Frankly speaking, we've got the skills to make it anywhere. However, this is where we grew up. If we leave, we'll become homeless wanderers.
say:32:1223215020:1.source_cn: 不怕你笑话，我们一身本领，到哪都能活。但这是我们长大的...

say:35:1223215021:1.text: We've tried leaving before, but the fish outside didn't suit our tastes, so we eventually came back.
say:35:1223215021:1.source_cn: 也不是没试过走，但兄弟们吃不惯外面的鱼，又回来了。

say:38:1223215022:1.text: Exactly! The fish out there just can't hold a candle to the ones we have here! By the way, I'm really craving some galefish right now!
say:38:1223215022:1.source_cn: 没错！外面的鱼根本没有锈锚港的肥，哈！说到这，我现在就...

say:41:1223215023:1.text: Hmph, the biggest galefish can only be caught during a storm. So just forget it, you noisy seagull...
say:41:1223215023:1.source_cn: 哼，最大的狂风鱼只有风暴天气才能抓到，你就算了！

say:42:1223215024:1.text: Are you looking down on me or something? How about we see who's better at fishing, sea slug?!
say:42:1223215024:1.source_cn: 嚯，敢嘲笑我？要不要来比比？

say:43:1223215025:0.text: I caught twenty last time. If I'm not mistaken, you only had fifteen, right?
say:43:1223215025:0.source_cn: 我上次的记录是二十条，你好像只有十五条吧？

say:44:1223215026:1.text: You rascal, it's only because I—

say:47:1223215027:1.text: Wait a minute. Since you guys are so good at catching fish...
say:47:1223215027:1.source_cn: 等等，你们既然这么擅长抓鱼……

choice_prompt:48:1223215027.text: Wait a minute. Since you guys are so good at catching fish...
choice_prompt:48:1223215027.source_cn: 等等，你们既然这么擅长抓鱼……

say:50:1223215028:0.text: That's right! Since you're having trouble finding a job, why don't you start your own business?
say:50:1223215028:0.source_cn: 对呀！你们既然找不到工作，干嘛不自己做生意？

say:51:1223215029:0.text: Hmm... selling fish? Yeah, that makes sense! We not only know how to catch them but also how to clean them.
say:51:1223215029:0.source_cn: 这……卖鱼？对啊，兄弟们不仅会抓还会处理鱼，很适合干这个！

say:54:1223215030:1.text: This... sounds like a good idea. Why didn't I think of it before...
say:54:1223215030:1.source_cn: 这……好像的确是个点子，我怎么没想到呢……

say:55:1223215031:1.text: That's it! From now on, we're going to sell fish!
say:55:1223215031:1.source_cn: 决定了！接下来，我们卖鱼！

say:56:1223215032:1.text: Way to go! Running your own business is definitely better than working for others!
say:56:1223215032:1.source_cn: 这就对了嘛，自己经营铺子，肯定比打工有出路！

choice:48:1:2.text: You can set up a fish stall.
choice:48:1:2.male: You can set up a fish stall.
choice:48:1:2.female: You can set up a fish stall.

choice:21:0:1.text: Don't return to your old ways.
choice:21:0:1.male: Don't return to your old ways.
choice:21:0:1.female: Don't return to your old ways.

say:58:1223215015:1.text: I—I'm just blowing off some steam...
say:58:1223215015:1.source_cn: 我、我只是发泄一下不痛快……
say:58:1223215015:1.male: I—I'm just blowing off some steam...
say:58:1223215015:1.female: I—I'm just blowing off some steam...

say:61:1223215016:0.text: They just want to take it out on me. Let them do it; I'm used to it.
say:61:1223215016:0.source_cn: 他们只是想骂我，让他们骂吧，习惯了。
say:61:1223215016:0.male: They just want to take it out on me. Let them do it; I'm used to it.
say:61:1223215016:0.female: They just want to take it out on me. Let them do it; I'm used to it.

choice:21:2:3.text: Al means well for you guys.
choice:21:2:3.male: Al means well for you guys.
choice:21:2:3.female: Al means well for you guys.
